name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 1; Directive 2003/87/EC – Article 10a – § 2a – sub§ 1 – 4
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
part_text: By way of derogation from paragraph 2, third subparagraph, point (d), the maximum annual reduction rate to be applied for the update of the benchmark values for heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2027 to 2030 shall be reduced, after considering the sector-specific benchmarks referred to in paragraph 2ba, to a percentage rate value that makes full use of the additional amount referred to in paragraph 5a, and of the allowances referred to in the sixth subparagraph of paragraph 1, and ensures that no reduction pursuant to paragraph 5 applies.
